name: website-screenshot
title: Website Screenshot API: Full-Page PNG, JPEG, WebP & PDF
description: Screenshot any URL as PNG, JPEG, WebP or PDF: full page or viewport, desktop, tablet or mobile, or one element by CSS selector. Hides cookie banners, loads lazy images, retries slow pages. Returns a public file link per URL. $3 per 1,000 screenshots; failed URLs are free.
